text: <s>[INST] Translate to Old Norse: The wolf runs through the dark forest. [/INST] Úlfrinn rennr um hinn myrka skóg.</s>

<s>[INST] What is the significance of Yggdrasil in Norse mythology? [/INST] Yggdrasill er askr sá er stendur yfir ǫllum heimum. Hann er mestr ok beztr allra trjáa. Limar hans dreifast yfir heim allan ok standa yfir himni.</s>
<s>[INST] Translate to Old Norse: The raven speaks wisdom. [/INST] Hrafninn mælir speki.</s>
